title: Scoop: A powerful new model from startup Reflection is set to shake up the AI race
key_facts: Axios reported on 4 Oct 2026 that Reflection, an AI startup backed by Nvidia, is preparing to launch a high-performance open-weight model
The first model is to be unveiled soon
Early performance is expected to lag the leading US models but to compete with the top Chinese open-weight models
Axios, citing sources, said the model is strong enough for companies to build their own low-cost AI systems
Most of the most powerful open-weight models today come from Chinese companies
Reflection is working with South Korea's Shinsegae Group on a sovereign AI factory
Reflection has signed large contracts in recent weeks to lease Nvidia AI servers from Nebius and SpaceX
quote_evidence: Reflection, an AI startup backed by Nvidia, is preparing to launch a high-performance open-weight model, Axios reported on Oct. 4 local time.
Early performance is expected to lag cutting-edge U.S. models but be competitive with top Chinese open-weight models.
why_it_matters_hint: A US-made open-weight model would give companies a cheaper alternative to closed models and to Chinese open models.
notes: Axios blocked (403). Read Digital Today's relay of the Axios scoop. Scoop rests on unnamed sources; no launch date or model name.
